sample.question:
Apply the operation cards from left to right. What will be in slot 4 at the end?
Options:
[1] ember potency 1
[2] ember potency 3
[3] sun potency 1
[4] ember potency 5
[5] ember potency 4
[6] ember potency 2
[7] void potency 4
sample.analysis:
After card 1 (heat slot 5), slot 4 is void potency 3.
After card 2 (heat slot 4), slot 4 is void potency 4.
After card 3 (heat slot 5), slot 4 is void potency 4.
After card 4 (infuse slot 1), slot 4 is void potency 4.
The final state is void potency 4. Therefore choose option 7.

rules: heat: selected bottle potency increases by 1 up to 5.
cool: selected bottle potency decreases by 1 down to 1.
infuse: selected bottle element advances one step in the cycle ember -> sun -> leaf -> frost -> moon -> void -> ember.
decant: two selected bottles swap positions.
A cauldron mix has element equal to the cyclic sum of bottle elements and potency equal to 1 + (sum of potencies mod 5).
